title: Internal
description: Parameter for PDF to Image operation.

assetID.description: A file assetID. For more details click here .

outputType.description: If it is set to zipOfPageImages then the response will be provided as a zip response, otherwise if set as listOfPageImages the response will be provided as list of images as specified in the targetFormat.

notifiers.description: Specifies the notifiers to be invoked on the completion of job. To know more about notifiers, please see the documentation.

type.description: Specifies the notifier type. Currently supported value is "CALLBACK" only.

data.description: Specifies the data needed to invoke the notifier.
